notes.title: Update v1.0.7
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug causing the game to lock the player in a cutscene after pressing the pause button rapidly in succession when starting the cutscene;
 Added some direction indicators to one of the puzzle hints.

notes.title: Release date reveal!
notes.notes:
After 10 months of work, Tetradome is finally ready and will release next Friday, March 7th, 2025!!! The game will be available on the Steam store for Windows systems at 03:00 PM PST.
